asks: How the native agent loop decides to compact a conversation
Which status messages it emits around compaction

data_flow.step: Run::execute resolves the window: `ostra_core::pricing::context_window(&spec.route.model).unwrap_or(DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW)`. It starts `measured = 0`, `measured_len = 0`, `failed_compaction_at = None`.

At the top of each of up to MAX_TURNS (400) iterations it checks cancellation, builds the ChatRequest, and computes `next` (measured context plus 4-chars-per-token estimate of messages since `measured_len`).
Compaction runs only if all three hold: `next >= 0.95 * window`; the retry gate is open (`failed_compaction_at` is None, or `next >= at + 0.02 * window`); the last message has role User.
Run::compact emits Status 'Compacting the conversation: about {tokens} of {window} context tokens used.' where tokens is `next` (an estimate, not a measured value).

provider.compact(req, COMPACT_INSTRUCTIONS, cancel) runs. Anthropic: server-side summarize with beta compact-2026-09-04 on models whose caps allow it, else client-side fallback. OpenAI: /v1/responses/compact. Either falls back to compact_on_client on InvalidRequest. compact_on_client appends the instructions as a user turn, sets ToolChoice::None, and treats a non-empty EndTurn text answer as the summary.

On Ok, add_usage emits Turn (no call ids) and Usage deltas for the compaction request. Then Status 'Compacted the conversation into a summary.' when messages is Some, or 'Compaction returned no summary, so the run continues without it.' when None.

Some(window): AFTER_COMPACTION is appended as a user turn (merged into the last user message if the window ends on a user role), the window is stored via host.record_message("compaction", ...), `messages` is replaced, and failed_compaction_at is reset. No status is emitted at this step. None: failed_compaction_at = Some(next). Err(Cancelled): returns a Cancelled result with no further status. Other Err: Status 'Compaction failed, so the run continues without it: {e}', failed_compaction_at = Some(next).
The chat request for the turn then goes out with the (possibly compacted) messages. After the response, `measured` becomes the response's context_of(usage), which re-baselines the next estimate.

Every Status delta reaches EngineHost::emit, which stores summary_line(message) (whitespace collapsed, max 120 chars with an ellipsis) as the execution's summary via set_execution_summary, then forwards the delta unchanged.

patterns.description: Each turn, before the chat request, the loop computes `next` as the last measured context plus an estimate of messages added since. It compacts when `next >= 0.95 * window`, the retry gate allows it, and the last message is a user turn (no open tool call). The window comes from `ostra_core::pricing::context_window(model)` or 200,000 when unlisted. `measured` is set after each response to `context_of(usage)` (input + cache read + cache write + output tokens) and `measured_len` to the message count then. Unmeasured messages are estimated at 4 characters per token.

patterns.description: Run::compact emits one Status before calling the provider and one after it returns Ok. Between them it calls add_usage(&out.usage, vec![]), which emits a Turn delta with empty call_ids and a Usage delta, so the summarization request is billed in the execution total and appears as a call-less turn. On a provider Err, the `?` returns before the second Status and add_usage, so only the first Status and the caller's failure Status appear.

document.problem: The native loop (Run::execute) summarizes the conversation when the next request would fill 95% of the model's context window. Around that call it emits ExecutionDelta::Status messages through the ExecutionHost. The exact trigger conditions, the retry rule after a failed attempt, and the set and order of status strings are spread over Run::execute and Run::compact.

submit.findings_summary: Each turn the loop estimates the next request size as the last measured context plus 4-chars-per-token for newer messages. It compacts when that reaches 95% of the model's window (200k if unlisted), the last message is a user turn, and, after a failed attempt, the context has grown by 2% of the window. Run::compact emits 'Compacting the conversation: about {tokens} of {window} context tokens used.' before the provider call, then either 'Compacted the conversation into a summary.' or 'Compaction returned no summary, so the run continues without it.'. A provider error instead gives 'Compaction failed, so the run continues without it: {e}' from Run::execute, and cancellation returns Cancelled with no status. EngineHost::emit stores each status as a 120-character summary line, no existing test asserts the strings, and docs/internals/executors.md covers the behavior but not the messages.
